a.title: 1 · New chat. Start the stage agent with RUN_ID and the approved inputs of the previous stage
5 · Review the output against the stage checklist
7 · Approve, then start the next stage manually (NEXT_STEP)
2 · Read .github/contexts, rules, templates and the increment card
3 · Produce the artefact under output/RUN_ID/ with trace IDs (SPEC-*, TASK-*, CODE-*, APT-*, FT-*)
4 · Invoke Compliance Reviewer at the spec, plan and code gates; then stop and report NEXT_STEP
BLOCKED when inputs are missing or findings are unresolved; never improvise endpoints, screens or assumptions
6 · Human approval gate: PO (spec), FDA (plan, quality), FDE (tasks, code review, release), PO/PM (deploy)
Critical / High / Medium findings block until remediated or explicitly accepted. Low-only FAIL → REVIEW_GATE_WARNING, human disposition
Every stage is human-initiated. Stage agents are never chained automatically; a workflow prompt pauses after every step and continues only on explicit instruction.
